name: Wicklen
description: Trading automation, strategy development, analytics, and advanced execution built for Lighter.
longDescription:
Wicklen is a trading automation, analytics, and execution platform built specifically for Lighter mainnet perpetuals.

Wicklen combines strategy development and backtesting, automated trading bots, a robust full-featured trading terminal, advanced execution tools, account and bot analytics, and configurable risk monitoring.

Automated strategies include Grid, market making, DCA, Pairs, signal/webhook trading, and additional strategy bots. Users can connect multiple Lighter wallets and subaccounts while funds remain entirely in their Lighter accounts.

Analytics provide trade-level results derived from Lighter fills, performance by bot and market, drawdown, and live exposure. Guardian provides configurable risk monitoring and protective actions, while Crowd Radar and Hype Radar provide additional market research tools.

Wicklen is preparing to enter public beta.
